labels.description: The labels to add to the issue's existing labels. You can also pass an `array` of labels directly, but GitHub recommends passing an object with the `labels` key. To replace all of the labels for an issue, use "[Set labels for an issue](https://docs.github.com/rest/issues/labels#set-labels-for-an-issue)."

confidence.description: The confidence level for this label choice.

name.description: The name of the label to add.

rationale.description: Optional reasoning for adding this label.

suggest.description: If `true`, the label is stored as a pending suggestion for human review rather than applied directly.
